елаелело целую головку запечённого =чеснока= на обед?
bulgarian: You ever just eat a whole head of roasted =Garlic= for lunch?

english: I'm glad I picked up some extra cloves earlier this week.
french: Heureusement que j'ai acheté quelques gousses en plus, cette semaine.
russian: Хорошо, что я купила лишние головки на этой неделе.
bulgarian: I'm glad I picked up some extra cloves earlier this week.

english: I think we're going to have just enough =Garlic= for the rest of the day.
french: Je crois qu'il nous reste tout juste assez d'=ail= pour finir la journée.
russian: Думаю, нам хватит =чеснока= на весь день.
bulgarian: I think we're going to have just enough =Garlic= for the rest of the day.

english: Thank goodness Juniper opens the Bathhouse early.
french: Heureusement que Juniper ouvre les bains assez tôt.
russian: Хорошо, что Джунипер открывает купальню рано утром.
bulgarian: Thank goodness Juniper opens the Bathhouse early.

english: Ugh! That's the last time I work with so much garlic.
french: Argh ! C'est la dernière fois que je mets autant d'ail.
russian: Фуух! Больше я столько чеснока готовить не буду.
bulgarian: Ugh! That's the last time I work with so much garlic.

english: I was missing a few ingredients in the kitchen, so I popped on over. It's so convenient being just down the street!
french: Il me manquait quelques ingrédients, alors je suis passée. C'est tellement pratique d'être à côté du magasin !
russian: Мне не хватало пары ингредиентов на кухне, так что я забежала сюда. Удобно, что всё рядом!
bulgarian: I was missing a few ingredients in the kitchen, so I popped on over. It's so convenient being just down the street!

english: Maple and Luc keep talking about how much they liked the last tart I made, so I thought I'd check out what fruits the General Store has in stock.
french: Maple et Luc ont adoré ma dernière tarte aux fruits, alors je me suis dit que j'allais passer voir s'ils en ont reçu d'autres.
russian: Мэйпл и Люк всё говорят, как им понравился последний тарт, что я готовила, так что я решила проверить, какие фрукты есть в лавке.
bulgarian: Maple and Luc keep talking about how much they liked the last tart I made, so I thought I'd check out what fruits the General Store has in stock.

english: Valen told me that =Garlic= is a warming food, so I'm adding a bunch to tonight's special!
french: Valen m'a dit que l'=ail= était un aliment qui réchauffe, alors j'en ai mis plein dans le plat de ce soir.
russian: Вален мне сказала, что =чеснок= согревает. Так что я решила сегодня добавить побольше!
bulgarian: Valen told me that =Garlic= is a warming food, so I'm adding a bunch to tonight's special!

english: I can't believe I was one potato short! And so, here I am.
french: Il me manquait juste une seule pomme de terre, je n'y crois pas ! Donc me voilà.
russian: Невероятно, но мне не хватило одной картофелины! Так что я пришла сюда.
bulgarian: I can't believe I was one potato short! And so, here I am.

english: Carrots and potatoes... those sound nice for a winter soup, don't they?
french: Des carottes et des pommes de terre... Ça devrait faire une bonne soupe d'hiver, non ?
russian: Морковь и картофель... Для зимнего супа — то что надо.
bulgarian: Carrots and potatoes... those sound nice for a winter soup, don't they?

english: Maple found an old book on politics and she wants me to read it to her, for some reason. Being a big sister is tough!
french: Maple a trouvé un vieux livre sur la politique, et va comprendre pourquoi, elle veut que je le lui lise. Ça n'est pas facile d'être une grande sœur !
russian: Мэйпл нашла старую книгу про политику и хочет, чтобы я ей её почитала. Нелегко быть старшей сестрой!
bulgarian: Maple found an old book on politics and she wants me to read it to her, for some reason. Being a big sister is tough!

english: [Ari]! Lots of good stuff cooking today. Why don't you check out our menu?
french: [Ari], je prépare plein de choses délicieuses, aujourd'hui ! Tu as jeté un œil au menu ?
russian: [Ari]! Сегодня столько всего вкусного готовлю. Загляни в меню!
bulgarian: [Ari]! Lots of good stuff cooking today. Why don't you check out our menu?

english: Hey [Ari]! Insider tip: the special at the Inn is pretty good today!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Un petit conseil : tu devrais goûter le plat du jour !
russian: Эй, [Ari]! Секретик: блюдо дня в трактире сегодня реально классное!
bulgarian: Hey [Ari]! Insider tip: the special at the Inn is pretty good today!

english: Look at you! A bonafide cook. I'm going to have some competition soon!
french: Ça alors ?! Tu cuisines super bien ! Je vais bientôt avoir une sacrée concurrence !
russian: Смотри-ка! Настоящий повар! У меня появляется конкурент!
bulgarian: Look at you! A bonafide cook. I'm going to have some competition soon!

english: You must be the new farmer.
french: Je m'appelle Reina. Ma famille est propriétaire de l'$auberge du Dragon qui dort$. Ravie de faire ta connaissance, [Ari] !
russian: Меня зовут Рейна, моя семья владеет $трактиром «Спящий дракон»$. Приятно познакомиться, [Ari]!
bulgarian: You must be the new farmer.

english: My name is Reina, my family owns the $Sleeping Dragon Inn$. Nice to meet you, [Ari]!
french: Je suis curieuse. Pourquoi tu es à Mistria ?
russian: Так что привело тебя в Мистрию, если не секрет?
bulgarian: My name is Reina, my family owns the $Sleeping Dragon Inn$. Nice to meet you, [Ari]!

english: I've always dreamed of starting my own farm!
french: J'ai toujours rêvé de me lancer dans l'agriculture !
russian: Мне всегда хотелось свою ферму!
bulgarian: I've always dreamed of starting my own farm!

english: I heard there was free land up for grabs.
french: J'ai appris qu'on donnait des lopins de terre.
russian: Слухи были, что тут землю раздают.
bulgarian: I heard there was free land up for grabs.

english: So what brings you to Mistria, if you don't mind me asking?
french: C'est super ! J'ai hâte de voir ce que tu vas faire pousser...
russian: Это так здорово! Интересно, что ты будешь выращивать...
bulgarian: So what brings you to Mistria, if you don't mind me asking?

english: I've always dreamed of starting my own farm!
french: J'ai toujours rêvé d'avoir ma propre ferme !
bulgarian: I've always dreamed of starting my own farm!

english: I heard there was free land up for grabs.
french: On m'a dit qu'il y avait un terrain gratuit qui cherchait preneur.
bulgarian: I heard there was free land up for grabs.

english: Really? I'm excited to see what types of produce you'll grow...
french: Vraiment ? J'ai hâte de voir ce que tu vas faire pousser.
russian: Я обожаю еду, особенно когда она с местных ферм!
bulgarian: Really? I'm excited to see what types of produce you'll grow...

english: I have a passion for food, especially when it's locally sourced!
french: J'adore la nourriture, surtout les produits locaux !
russian: Аделина очень старалась над этим проектом. Честно говоря, я сомневалась, что кто-то им заинтересуется...
bulgarian: I have a passion for food, especially when it's locally sourced!

english: Adeline worked really hard on this initiative. I have to admit I wasn't sure anyone would take her up on it...
french: Adeline s'est vraiment investie dans ce projet. Au début, je pensais que personne ne serait intéressé...
russian:
Но хорошо, что ты

откликнулись

откликнуласьоткликнулсяоткликнулось! Очень интересно, что ты будешь выращивать!
bulgarian: Adeline worked really hard on this initiative. I have to admit I wasn't sure anyone would take her up on it...

english: I'm glad you did though, I can't wait to see what types of produce you'll grow!
french: Mais je suis heureuse que tu sois là. J'ai hâte de voir ce que tu vas faire pousser !
russian: Надеюсь, у тебя как-нибудь найдётся минутка попробовать мою стряпню. Я буду ждать с нетерпением!
bulgarian: I'm glad you did though, I can't wait to see what types of produce you'll grow!

english: Well, I hope you'll stop by and try my cooking some time. I'll be looking forward to it!
french: Je compte sur toi pour venir à l'auberge goûter mes plats. À très vite !
bulgarian: Well, I hope you'll stop by and try my cooking some time. I'll be looking forward to it!

english: Oh, hello!
french: Oh, bonjour ! C'est toi qui as repris la petite ferme ?
russian:
О, привет! Ты, наверное,

новые фермер

новая фермеркановый фермерновое фермер!
bulgarian: Oh, hello!

english: Hey! Come hang out a minute! I miss my friend [Ari]!
french: Hé, viens me voir plus souvent ! Tu me manques, [Ari] !
russian:
Эй! Зайди на минутку! А то я скучаю по тебе, [Ari], —

своим друзьям

своей подругесвоему другусвоему другу!
bulgarian: Hey! Come hang out a minute! I miss my friend [Ari]!

english: Well I accidentally made a "Reina's fourteen."
french: Mais sans le faire exprès, j'en ai fait « quatorze à la douzaine ».
russian: Так вышло, что я случайно сделала «Рейнины четырнадцать».
bulgarian: Well I accidentally made a "Reina's fourteen."

english: Enjoy!
french: Tiens !
russian: Угощайся!
bulgarian: Enjoy!

english: Have you heard of a baker's dozen? We make an extra one to taste test.
french: Tu connais la signification de « treize à la douzaine » ? On en prépare toujours un de plus pour y goûter.
russian: Знаешь про пекарскую дюжину? Мы всегда выпекаем на одно пирожное больше, чтобы попробовать на вкус.
bulgarian: Have you heard of a baker's dozen? We make an extra one to taste test.

english: Hey, [Ari]! You know, if you have anything you really like to eat, let me know. Maybe we can add it to the menu at the Inn!
french: Bonjour, [Ari] ! Tu sais, si tu as très envie de quelque chose, n'hésite pas à me prévenir. Je verrais si je peux l'ajouter au menu de l'auberge !
russian: Эй, [Ari]! Если у тебя есть любимое блюдо — скажи. Может, добавим его в меню трактира!
bulgarian: Hey, [Ari]! You know, if you have anything you really like to eat, let me know. Maybe we can add it to the menu at the Inn!

english: Or you can just talk to me!
french: Et tu peux toujours venir me parler !
russian: Ну или просто поболтать со мной!
bulgarian: Or you can just talk to me!

english: The Inn is a great place to swing by if you're looking for a bite to eat or some company, [Ari]!
french: [Ari], si tu as un petit creux, ou plus simplement si tu cherches un peu de compagnie, l'auberge est l'endroit indiqué !
russian: Трактир — лучшее место, если хочешь перекусить или пообщаться, [Ari]!
bulgarian: The Inn is a great place to swing by if you're looking for a bite to eat or some company, [Ari]!

english: I hope Vera comes through with the next Saturday Market... I love seeing her, and Ma can get all her gossip out.
french: J'espère que Vera sera au marché, samedi... J'adore aller la voir, et maman peut lui raconter tous les derniers potins.
russian: Надеюсь, Вера заглянет на следующий Субботний базар... я её обожаю, и мама сможет все сплетни перемусолить.
bulgarian: I hope Vera comes through with the next Saturday Market... I love seeing her, and Ma can get all her gossip out.

english: Wow, do I feel good after that!
french: Aaah, je me sens en pleine forme, maintenant.
russian: Ох, как же хорошо после такого!
bulgarian: Wow, do I feel good after that!

english: The bath's hot, [Ari]!
french: Le bain est très chaud, [Ari] !
russian: Ванна горячая, [Ari]!
bulgarian: The bath's hot, [Ari]!

english: Folks have really been enjoying the soup today! I should make some more.
french: Tout le monde a adoré la soupe d'aujourd'hui ! Je devrais en faire encore.
russian: Людям очень нравится сегодняшний суп! Надо сварить ещё.
bulgarian: Folks have really been enjoying the soup today! I should make some more.

english: Want something to eat, [Ari]? Pull up a chair!
french: Tu veux manger un morceau, [Ari] ? Assieds-toi !
russian: Хочешь перекусить, [Ari]? Присаживайся!
bulgarian: Want something to eat, [Ari]? Pull up a chair!

english: Thanks to Eiland, I always know I'll sell at least one.
french: Avec Eiland, je suis certaine d'en vendre au moins un.
russian: Спасибо Эйланду, я могу быть уверена, что один точно продастся.
bulgarian: Thanks to Eiland, I always know I'll sell at least one.

english: I'm brainstorming a new cake recipe!
french: Je suis en train de mettre au point une nouvelle recette de gâteau !
russian: Я обдумываю новый рецепт торта!
bulgarian: I'm brainstorming a new cake recipe!

english: The Inn's bustling these days, but I always have time for you, [Ari]!
french: On a pas mal de clients à l'auberge ces jours-ci, mais j'ai toujours le temps pour toi, [Ari] !
russian: В трактире сейчас людно, но для тебя у меня всегда найдётся время, [Ari]!
bulgarian: The Inn's bustling these days, but I always have time for you, [Ari]!

english: Don't feel like you're interrupting me if you need something!
french: Ne va pas croire que tu me déranges. Fais signe s'il te faut quelque chose !
russian: Не думай, что мешаешь, если что-то нужно!
bulgarian: Don't feel like you're interrupting me if you need something!

english: Pull up a chair, [Ari]! I can get something started for you, just say the word!
french: Mets-toi à table, [Ari] ! Si tu as envie de quelque chose, tu n'as qu'à me prévenir !
russian: Садись, [Ari]! Могу что-нибудь приготовить, только скажи!
bulgarian: Pull up a chair, [Ari]! I can get something started for you, just say the word!

english: Celine uses them for composting, which is kind of poetic if you think about it.
french: Céline s'en sert pour son compost, ce qui a un côté assez poétique.
russian: Селин использует их для компоста, и это как-то даже поэтично, если подумать.
bulgarian: Celine uses them for composting, which is kind of poetic if you think about it.

english: We always end up with a lot of scraps after a day of cooking.
french: Il y a toujours beaucoup de déchets, après une journée passée à cuisiner.
russian: После дня готовки остаётся куча отходов.
bulgarian: We always end up with a lot of scraps after a day of cooking.

english: It's a sleepy Sunday! Come in and relax with me before the new week starts!
french: C'est un dimanche relax ! Viens te détendre avec moi avant que la semaine ne recommence !
russian: Сегодня сонное воскресенье! Заходи, отдохни со мной, пока не началась новая неделя!
bulgarian: It's a sleepy Sunday! Come in and relax with me before the new week starts!

english: Hi [Ari]! Go on and make yourself at home.
french: Salut [Ari] ! Mets-toi à l'aise et fais comme chez toi.
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Располагайся, как дома.
bulgarian: Hi [Ari]! Go on and make yourself at home.

english: The kitchen is so cozy in the fall! I love it!
french: Je me sens si bien dans la cuisine, en automne ! J'adore !
russian: На кухне осенью так уютно! Я просто в восторге!
bulgarian: The kitchen is so cozy in the fall! I love it!

english: I used to hate doing inventory, but now I think of it as a gift for tomorrow's Reina.
french: Avant, je détestais faire l'inventaire. Maintenant, je vois ça comme un cadeau de la Reina de demain.
russian: Раньше я ненавидела вести учёт, а теперь думаю, что, если сделаю его сегодня, это будет подарок для завтрашней Рейны.
bulgarian: I used to hate doing inventory, but now I think of it as a gift for tomorrow's Reina.

english: Balor's been staying at the Inn for a good long while now, and I still don't know the first thing about him! Maybe YOU can get him out of that shell, [Ari].
french: Balor séjourne à l'auberge depuis un bon moment maintenant, et je ne sais toujours rien de lui ! Tu arriveras peut-être à lui tirer les vers du nez, [Ari].
russian: Балор уже долго живёт в трактире, а я до сих пор о нём ничего не знаю! Может, ТЫ его разговоришь, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Balor's been staying at the Inn for a good long while now, and I still don't know the first thing about him! Maybe YOU can get him out of that shell, [Ari].

english: Maybe YOU can get him out of that shell, [Ari].
french: Tu arriveras peut-être à lui tirer les vers du nez, [Ari].
russian: Может, у ТЕБЯ получится пробиться сквозь его броню, [Ari].
bulgarian: Maybe YOU can get him out of that shell, [Ari].

english: Balor likes to keep to himself. I still don't know the first thing about him!
french: Balor séjourne à l'auberge depuis un bon moment maintenant, et je ne sais toujours rien de lui ! Tu arriveras peut-être à lui tirer les vers du nez, [Ari].
russian: Балор уже довольно давно живёт в нашем трактире, а я до сих пор о нём ничего не знаю! Может, у ТЕБЯ получится пробиться сквозь его броню, [Ari].
bulgarian: Balor likes to keep to himself. I still don't know the first thing about him!

english: Landen and Ryis are a funny pair... one won't stop talking and the other won't start! Sometimes it's hard to believe they're related!
french: Landen et Ryis forment une drôle d'équipe... L'un n'arrête pas de parler et l'autre est muet comme une carpe ! Parfois, je me demande s'ils sont vraiment parents !
russian: Ланден и Риз — забавная парочка... один не замолкает, другой держит рот на замке! И ведь родственники!
bulgarian: Landen and Ryis are a funny pair... one won't stop talking and the other won't start! Sometimes it's hard to believe they're related!

english: It reminds me of how everyone looked after me, Adeline and Celine when we were their age!
french: Ça me rappelle la façon dont tout le monde s'occupait d'Adeline, Céline et moi au même âge !
russian: Напоминает, как когда-то все заботились о нас с Аделиной и Селин!
bulgarian: It reminds me of how everyone looked after me, Adeline and Celine when we were their age!

english: It's so sweet how the whole town looks after Maple, Luc and Dell.
french: C'est vraiment adorable de la part des habitants de la ville de s'occuper si bien de Maple, Luc et Dell.
russian: Так мило, что весь город заботится о Мэйпл, Люке и Делл.
bulgarian: It's so sweet how the whole town looks after Maple, Luc and Dell.

english: Between you and me, [Ari], I've always wondered what's going on with Errol, Landen and Terithia... it looks like a little bit of a love triangle to me! You better tell me any juicy gossip, ok?
french: [Ari], je me suis toujours demandé ce qu'il y avait entre Errol, Landen et Terithia. Ils ne seraient pas tous les deux amoureux d'elle ?! Si tu as des infos à ce sujet, viens me voir !
russian: Скажу по секрету, [Ari]: по-моему, между Эрролом, Ланденом и Теризией что-то есть... Неужто любовный треугольник? Если узнаешь слухи, расскажи, ладно?
bulgarian: Between you and me, [Ari], I've always wondered what's going on with Errol, Landen and Terithia... it looks like a little bit of a love triangle to me! You better tell me any juicy gossip, ok?

english: Me too, honestly.
french: Et moi aussi, à vrai dire.
russian: Честно? Я тоже.
bulgarian: Me too, honestly.

english: Maple and Luc are crazy for =Cheese= lately.
french: Ces derniers temps, Maple et Luc ne jurent que par le =fromage=.
russian: Мэйпл и Люк в последнее время без ума от =сыра=.
bulgarian: Maple and Luc are crazy for =Cheese= lately.

english: Luc is always showing me his bug friends! At first it was hard because I thought bugs were icky, but now I think they're kinda cute...
french: Luc n'arrête pas de me montrer ses insectes ! Au début, j'avais du mal parce que je les trouvais plutôt répugnants, mais au final, ils sont assez mignons...
russian: Люк постоянно показывает мне своих друзей-жуков! Сначала было тяжело: я ведь считала насекомых фу-фу, — а теперь они вроде даже милые...
bulgarian: Luc is always showing me his bug friends! At first it was hard because I thought bugs were icky, but now I think they're kinda cute...

english: I'm having such a nice day off! Look at all those pretty fall colors!
french: Ma journée de repos est très agréable ! Ces tonalités automnales sont si jolies !
russian: Сегодня у меня такой чудесный выходной! Посмотри на все эти красивые осенние краски!
bulgarian: I'm having such a nice day off! Look at all those pretty fall colors!

english: Maybe I'll pick some for Luc and Maple!
french: Je vais peut-être en cueillir pour Maple et Luc, tout à l'heure.
russian: Может, соберу немного для Люка и Мэйпл!
bulgarian: Maybe I'll pick some for Luc and Maple!

english: The $Violas$ are so pretty! Look, [Ari]!
french: Et ces $violettes$ sont magnifiques ! Regarde, [Ari] !
russian: Какие красивые $фиалки$! Смотри, [Ari]!
bulgarian: The $Violas$ are so pretty! Look, [Ari]!

english: That's made Luc really happy! Celine is his hero!
french: Luc est très heureux ! Céline est son héroïne !
russian: Это так радует Люка! Селин — его героиня!
bulgarian: That's made Luc really happy! Celine is his hero!

english: Ever since Celine started doing upkeep on the manor garden, it seems like the insects that rely on the garden have also been thriving.
french: Depuis que Céline s'occupe du jardin du manoir, les insectes qui y nichent semblent se porter encore mieux.
russian: С тех пор, как Селин стала ухаживать за садом особняка, насекомым, которые там обитают, тоже хорошо стало житься!
bulgarian: Ever since Celine started doing upkeep on the manor garden, it seems like the insects that rely on the garden have also been thriving.

english: Those are $Violas$, and those are $Celosia$! Aren't they pretty?
french: Ça, c'est des $violettes$, et ça, des $célosies$ ! Elles sont belles, non ?
russian: Там — $фиалки$, а вон там — $целозии$! Красивые, правда?
bulgarian: Those are $Violas$, and those are $Celosia$! Aren't they pretty?

english: Celine taught me the names of the flowers that she grows on the Manor grounds in fall!
french: Céline m'a appris le nom des fleurs qu'elle fait pousser dans les jardins du manoir à l'automne.
russian: Селин рассказала мне, как называются цветы, которые она выращивает у особняка осенью.
bulgarian: Celine taught me the names of the flowers that she grows on the Manor grounds in fall!

english: Maple and Luc were so cute this morning! I'm such a lucky big sister.
french: Maple et Luc étaient adorables, ce matin ! J'ai beaucoup de chance d'être leur grande sœur.
russian: Мэйпл и Люк сегодня утром были такие милые! Я такая счастливая старшая сестра.
bulgarian: Maple and Luc were so cute this morning! I'm such a lucky big sister.

english: I tried to let Maple down easy that she can't be a princess when she grows up, but she dragged out the rules and regulations of Mistria, and I guess there are a lot of loopholes?
french: J'ai tenté d'expliquer à Maple qu'elle ne pourrait pas devenir princesse une fois adulte, mais elle a sorti la constitution de Mistria et effectivement, il y a pas mal de failles.
russian: Я пыталась мягко объяснить Мэйпл, что она не сможет стать принцессой, когда вырастет, но она достала правила Мистрии — и, кажется, там полно лазеек.
bulgarian: I tried to let Maple down easy that she can't be a princess when she grows up, but she dragged out the rules and regulations of Mistria, and I guess there are a lot of loopholes?

english: Honestly it's Eiland and Adeline's problem at this point.
french: À dire vrai, c'est à Adeline et Eiland de gérer désormais.
russian: Думаю, теперь это проблема Эйланда и Аделины.
bulgarian: Honestly it's Eiland and Adeline's problem at this point.

english: Prep goes so much faster since I commissioned a set from him.
french: Je passe bien moins de temps à parer la viande ou émincer les légumes depuis que je lui en ai acheté de nouveaux.
russian: С ними подготовка идёт куда быстрее!
bulgarian: Prep goes so much faster since I commissioned a set from him.

english: March is such a crank, but his knives are amazing.
french: March est un drôle d'hurluberlu, mais ses couteaux sont de très bonne qualité.
russian: Март такой ворчун, но его ножи — потрясающие.
bulgarian: March is such a crank, but his knives are amazing.

english: I've got some killer ideas for next week's menu. Keep an eye out!
french: J'ai des idées fantastiques pour le menu de la semaine prochaine. J'espère que tu y goûteras !
russian: У меня классные идеи для меню на следующую неделю. Следи за обновлениями!
bulgarian: I've got some killer ideas for next week's menu. Keep an eye out!

english: I'm usually in the kitchen cooking, so working the till is a nice change of pace.
french: En général, je suis aux fourneaux, alors ça me change un peu de m'occuper de la caisse.
russian: Я обычно на кухне, но работать за кассой — приятная смена обстановки.
bulgarian: I'm usually in the kitchen cooking, so working the till is a nice change of pace.

english: Ma and I have got this kitchen humming! There's already some folks trickling in... nothing like a good stew after coming in from the rain.
french: Maman et moi sommes bien affairées derrière les fourneaux ! Il y a déjà du monde qui arrive... Rien ne vaut une bonne assiette de ragoût quand il pleut.
russian: Мы с мамой так наладили кухню, что она просто поёт! Уже начинают приходить гости... ничего нет лучше, чем горячее рагу после дождя.
bulgarian: Ma and I have got this kitchen humming! There's already some folks trickling in... nothing like a good stew after coming in from the rain.

english: Today's menu at the Sleeping Dragon is going to be curry, stews... maybe some fresh bread? Everything you could want to get cozy after a walk in the rain.
french: Aujourd'hui, au Dragon qui dort, nous proposons du curry et du ragoût... Peut-être un peu de pain frais aussi ? Tout ce qu'il faut après avoir marché sous la pluie.
russian: Сегодня в меню «Спящего дракона» карри, рагу... может, свежий хлеб? Всё, чтобы согреться после прогулки под дождём.
bulgarian: Today's menu at the Sleeping Dragon is going to be curry, stews... maybe some fresh bread? Everything you could want to get cozy after a walk in the rain.

english: A lot of folks gather at the Inn on rainy days, so I'm stocking up... gotta be sure there's enough to feed every guest and then some!
french: Beaucoup de gens viennent à l'auberge, les jours de pluie, alors je fais des provisions... Il faut prévoir suffisamment pour tous les clients, et même un peu plus !
russian: В дождь в трактире собирается много народу, так что я делаю запасы... нужно быть уверенной, что еды хватит всем — и ещё останется!
bulgarian: A lot of folks gather at the Inn on rainy days, so I'm stocking up... gotta be sure there's enough to feed every guest and then some!

english: And we always keep the soup pot going for people coming out of the rain!
french: Et il y a toujours de la soupe chaude pour les gens qui arrivent détrempés !
russian: И у нас всегда стоит суп для тех, кто приходит с улицы!
bulgarian: And we always keep the soup pot going for people coming out of the rain!

english: Rainy days are so busy at the Inn! But I always look forward to whoever might drop by.
french: Il y a toujours beaucoup de monde à l'auberge quand il pleut, mais on ne sait jamais exactement qui passera.
russian: Дождливые дни в трактире всегда такие загруженные! Но я люблю каждого, кто заходит ко мне.
bulgarian: Rainy days are so busy at the Inn! But I always look forward to whoever might drop by.

english: A rainy day like this would be perfect for snuggling up with a good book...
french: Une journée pluvieuse comme aujourd'hui serait parfaite pour se blottir au chaud avec un bon bouquin...
russian: В такой дождливый день самое то — устроиться поуютнее с хорошей книгой...
bulgarian: A rainy day like this would be perfect for snuggling up with a good book...

english: The sound of the rain is so cozy... it makes me want to relax and read a book.
french: Le bruit de la pluie est tellement réconfortant... Ça me donne envie de me détendre en lisant un livre.
russian: Шум дождя такой уютный... так и хочется расслабиться и почитать книгу.
bulgarian: The sound of the rain is so cozy... it makes me want to relax and read a book.

english: Nothing better than some soup on a rainy day.
french: Rien ne vaut un bon potage un jour de pluie.
russian: Нет ничего лучше супа в дождливый день.
bulgarian: Nothing better than some soup on a rainy day.

english: I can't wait to unwind with a good book later...
french: J'ai hâte de me relaxer avec un bon livre, tout à l'heure...
russian: Скорее бы уже вечером отдохнуть с хорошей книгой...
bulgarian: I can't wait to unwind with a good book later...

english: There's so much to do today!
french: Il y a tellement à faire, aujourd'hui !
russian: Сегодня столько дел!
bulgarian: There's so much to do today!

english: Now where were we... Ah yes. The duchy's complex politics meant there was no clear successor-
french: Alors, on en était où...? Ah oui. La situation politique inextricable du duché empêcha la désignation formelle d'un successeur...
russian: Так, на чём мы остановились... Ах да. Сложная политика герцогства означала, что явного наследника не было...
bulgarian: Now where were we... Ah yes. The duchy's complex politics meant there was no clear successor-

english: Watch me!
french: Je te le garantis !
russian: Вот увидишь!
bulgarian: Watch me!

english: Phew! I'm a little behind schedule, but I'll be ready by the time people start rolling in!
french: Pfiou ! J'ai pris un peu en retard, mais je serai fin prête pour les premiers clients.
russian: Фух! Немного отстаю от графика, но к приходу людей я успею!
bulgarian: Phew! I'm a little behind schedule, but I'll be ready by the time people start rolling in!

english: Welcome to the Sleeping Dragon Inn, [Ari]! Make yourself at home!
french: Bienvenue à l'auberge du Dragon qui dort, [Ari] ! Mets-toi à l'aise.
russian: Добро пожаловать в трактир «Спящий дракон», [Ari]! Чувствуй себя как дома!
bulgarian: Welcome to the Sleeping Dragon Inn, [Ari]! Make yourself at home!

english: It's always nice when you come around, [Ari]. Now, what can I get for you?
french: C'est toujours un plaisir de te voir, [Ari] ! Dis-moi, qu'est-ce qui te ferait plaisir ?
russian: Всегда приятно, когда ты заглядываешь, [Ari]. Ну, что приготовить для тебя?
bulgarian: It's always nice when you come around, [Ari]. Now, what can I get for you?

english: Take a peek at the menu and let me know if I can cook something up for you, [Ari]!
french: Jette un œil au menu et dis-moi ce que tu veux que je te prépare, [Ari] !
russian: Загляни в меню и скажи, чего тебе хочется, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Take a peek at the menu and let me know if I can cook something up for you, [Ari]!

english: Sometimes I even run into Celine! Or you!
french: Et parfois je tombe sur Céline ! Ou sur toi !
russian: Иногда даже встречаю Селин! Или тебя!
bulgarian: Sometimes I even run into Celine! Or you!

english: It's nice that I can pop over here if we're missing anything in the kitchen.
french: Si jamais il nous manque quelque chose en cuisine, je peux toujours faire un saut ici. C'est très pratique !
russian: Хорошо, что я могу забежать сюда, если чего-то не хватает на кухне.
bulgarian: It's nice that I can pop over here if we're missing anything in the kitchen.

english: I love running into Elsie when I'm out here. She has the best stories!
french: J'adore croiser Elsie quand je me balade. Elle a toujours des histoires très intéressantes !
russian: Обожаю натыкаться на Элси, когда выхожу сюда. У неё лучшие истории!
bulgarian: I love running into Elsie when I'm out here. She has the best stories!

english: And she just... disappeared the jar!
french: Elle a simplement... fait disparaître le bocal !
russian: И она её просто... развоплотила!
bulgarian: And she just... disappeared the jar!

english: She didn't even offer to help clean up! There were pickles everywhere!
french: Elle n'a même pas proposé de m'aider à nettoyer. Il y avait des cornichons partout !
russian: И даже не предложила за собой убрать! А там повсюду огурцы валялись!
bulgarian: She didn't even offer to help clean up! There were pickles everywhere!

english: I asked Seridia to help me open a pickle jar the other day...
french: J'ai demandé à Seridia de m'aider à ouvrir un bocal de cornichons, l'autre jour...
russian: Недавно я попросила Серидию помочь мне открыть банку солёных огурцов...
bulgarian: I asked Seridia to help me open a pickle jar the other day...

english: I left a =Crystal Berry Pie= on the counter to cool, and it suddenly up and vanished, like magic!
french: J'avais laissé une =tarte aux baies de cristal= à refroidir sur le comptoir, et elle s'est volatilisée d'un coup, comme par magie !
russian: Я поставила =пирог из кристальных ягод= остывать на стойку, а он вдруг взял и исчез! Какая-то магия!
bulgarian: I left a =Crystal Berry Pie= on the counter to cool, and it suddenly up and vanished, like magic!

english: I wonder where it flew off to...
french: Je me demande où elle s'est envolée...
russian: Интересно, и куда же он улетел...
bulgarian: I wonder where it flew off to...

english: So weird...
french: C'est bizarre...
russian: Как странно...
bulgarian: So weird...

english: I nibbled so much while working in the kitchen, I ended up skipping dinner.
french: J'ai tellement grignoté en cuisinant que j'ai fini par me passer de dîner.
russian: Я столько всего понадкусывала на кухне, что в итоге пропустила ужин.
bulgarian: I nibbled so much while working in the kitchen, I ended up skipping dinner.

english: That's wrong, but it's also really cute...
french: Il se trompe, mais je la trouve mignonne, cette erreur...
russian: Это неправильно, но и очень мило...
bulgarian: That's wrong, but it's also really cute...

english: Olric's always calling it "The Sleepy Dragon Inn".
french: Olric appelle toujours cet endroit « l'auberge du Dragon qui sort ».
russian: Ольрик постоянно называет нас «Трактир "Сонный драгун"».
bulgarian: Olric's always calling it "The Sleepy Dragon Inn".

english: What a nice, slow day. I'm always a little sleepier after Market Day.
french: C'est une journée calme et reposante. Je me sens toujours un peu fatiguée, les lendemains de marché.
russian: Какой приятный спокойный день. После базарного дня я всегда немного сонная.
bulgarian: What a nice, slow day. I'm always a little sleepier after Market Day.

english: You hungry, [Ari]? The soup came out pretty good today. Don't be shy now, grab a bowl!
french: Tu as un petit creux, [Ari] ? La soupe est vraiment bonne, aujourd'hui. Va donc te servir un bol !
russian:
Голодны

ГолоднаГолоденГолодное, [Ari]? Суп сегодня получился отличный. Не стесняйся, бери миску!
bulgarian: You hungry, [Ari]? The soup came out pretty good today. Don't be shy now, grab a bowl!

english: The soup came out nice today, in my humble opinion.
french: En toute modestie, je trouve que la soupe est bonne aujourd'hui.
russian: По моему скромному мнению, суп сегодня удался.
bulgarian: The soup came out nice today, in my humble opinion.

english: Hi, [Ari]! Take a seat and have yourself something tasty!
french: Coucou, [Ari] ! Assieds-toi et commande ce qui te tente !
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Садись, перекуси чем-нибудь вкусненьким!
bulgarian: Hi, [Ari]! Take a seat and have yourself something tasty!

english: Don't be all shy about it!
french: Fais comme chez toi !
russian: Не стесняйся!
bulgarian: Don't be all shy about it!

english: There's the free soup, and our menu at the front, but if you ever want to make a meal yourself you're more than welcome to use our kitchen!
french: On te propose notre soupe gratuite ou le menu du jour est affiché au niveau de la caisse. Mais si tu veux te cuisiner quelque chose, aucun problème !
russian:
Есть бесплатный суп и меню у входа, но если хочешь приготовить что-то

сами

самасамсамо — кухня твоя!
bulgarian: There's the free soup, and our menu at the front, but if you ever want to make a meal yourself you're more than welcome to use our kitchen!

english: Folks really went through the soup today! I'll have to make sure I remember this recipe... I was just winging it!
french: Tout le monde s'est jeté sur la soupe, aujourd'hui ! Il faudra que je me rappelle bien de la recette... J'ai improvisé !
russian: Суп сегодня вмиг разошёлся! Надо постараться запомнить рецепт... Я ведь придумывала на ходу!
bulgarian: Folks really went through the soup today! I'll have to make sure I remember this recipe... I was just winging it!

english: I'm using some spices that Terithia gave me. Gotta make sure I get the flavor balance juuuust right...
french: J'utilise des épices que m'a données Terithia. Je fais toujours très attention à équilibrer parfaitement les saveurs...
russian: Решила попробовать специи, которые мне принесла Теризия. Пытаюсь соблюсти идеальный баланс вкусов...
bulgarian: I'm using some spices that Terithia gave me. Gotta make sure I get the flavor balance juuuust right...

english: Always a good idea to be well stocked up on an Inn Night.
french: Je préfère avoir trop que pas assez, pour la soirée à l'auberge.
russian: Запастись перед вечером в трактире — всегда хорошая идея.
bulgarian: Always a good idea to be well stocked up on an Inn Night.

english: I like to drop by the General Store on Friday before everyone starts gathering!
french: J'aime bien aller au magasin général le vendredi, avant que tout le monde ne commence à arriver !
russian: Люблю заглянуть в лавку в пятницу, пока народ не собрался!
bulgarian: I like to drop by the General Store on Friday before everyone starts gathering!

english: Whew... the kitchen gets pretty hot in the summer!
french: Pfiou... Il fait chaud dans la cuisine, en été.
russian: Фух... летом на кухне очень жарко!
bulgarian: Whew... the kitchen gets pretty hot in the summer!

english: Ma and Pa usually have their hands full with Maple and Luc, so I've been taking on more at the Inn these days. I don't mind... I LOVE to cook!
french: Maman et papa ont du boulot avec Maple et Luc, alors je les aide de plus en plus à l'auberge. Ça ne me dérange pas... J'ADORE cuisiner !
russian: Ма и па обычно заняты Мэйпл и Люком, так что я беру на себя больше дел в трактире. Мне не жалко... Я ОБОЖАЮ готовить!
bulgarian: Ma and Pa usually have their hands full with Maple and Luc, so I've been taking on more at the Inn these days. I don't mind... I LOVE to cook!

english: What a great day of taste testing! I saved a slice of cake for you, [Ari]!
french: C'est la journée idéale pour goûter de nouvelles recettes ! Je t'ai gardé une part de gâteau, [Ari] !
russian: Какой классный день дегустаций! Я оставила кусочек торта для тебя, [Ari]!
bulgarian: What a great day of taste testing! I saved a slice of cake for you, [Ari]!

english: Let's add both!
french: Je vais mettre les deux !
russian: Добавим оба!
bulgarian: Let's add both!

english: I'm tinkering with a new salad recipe, and it's tasting pretty good, but something's missing. Lemon? Pepper?
french: Je suis en train de mettre la touche finale à une nouvelle salade. Elle est bonne, mais il manque un petit quelque chose. Du citron ? Ou alors du poivre ?
russian: Я экспериментирую с новым рецептом салата. Получается неплохо, но чего-то не хватает. Лимона? Перца?
bulgarian: I'm tinkering with a new salad recipe, and it's tasting pretty good, but something's missing. Lemon? Pepper?

english: Terithia's eaten fish I've never heard of, so I'm always taking notes!
french: Terithia a goûté des poissons dont je n'avais jamais entendu parler. Je prends toujours des notes quand on discute !
russian: Теризия пробовала рыбу, о которой я даже не слышала. Я всегда делаю заметки!
bulgarian: Terithia's eaten fish I've never heard of, so I'm always taking notes!

english: Potatoes, tomatoes... tomatoes, potatoes...
french: Des patates, des tomates... Des tomates, des patates...
russian: Картошка, помидоры... помидоры, картошка...
bulgarian: Potatoes, tomatoes... tomatoes, potatoes...

english: She's always looking out for him.
french: Elle prend toujours soin de lui.
russian: Она всегда о нём заботится.
bulgarian: She's always looking out for him.

english: Maple's so good with Luc!
french: Maple est si gentille avec Luc !
russian: Мэйпл так хорошо управляется с Люком!
bulgarian: Maple's so good with Luc!

english: I'll have to write it down later!
french: Il va falloir que je la consigne par écrit tout à l'heure !
russian: Надо будет потом её записать!
bulgarian: I'll have to write it down later!

english: Oooh I just came up with an idea for a recipe...
french: Oooh, je viens juste d'avoir une idée de recette...
russian: О-о-о, мне только что пришла в голову идея для рецепта...
bulgarian: Oooh I just came up with an idea for a recipe...

english: What's my girl Celine up to? I haven't seen her in a little bit.
french: Je me demande ce que fait ma copine Céline. Ça fait un moment que je ne l'ai pas vue.
russian: Что там делает моя подружка Селин? Давно её не видела.
bulgarian: What's my girl Celine up to? I haven't seen her in a little bit.

english: I hope my girls make it over here! I'd love to catch up with them.
french: J'espère que mes copines viendront ! Ça me ferait très plaisir de les voir.
russian: Надеюсь, мои девчонки зайдут сюда! Хочу поболтать с ними.
bulgarian: I hope my girls make it over here! I'd love to catch up with them.

english: Hi, [Ari]! I'll be minding the kitchen, but don't hesitate to give a yell if you need something!
french: Coucou, [Ari] ! Je suis aux fourneaux aujourd'hui, mais n'hésite pas si tu veux quelque chose en particulier !
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Я на кухне, но не стесняйся звать, если что-то нужно!
bulgarian: Hi, [Ari]! I'll be minding the kitchen, but don't hesitate to give a yell if you need something!

english: Balor's supply runs have been a help, don't get me wrong.
french: Le ravitaillement de Balor nous aide, je ne dis pas le contraire.
russian: Не пойми меня неправильно, поставки Балора выручают.
bulgarian: Balor's supply runs have been a help, don't get me wrong.

english: But having you here to run $[farm_name]$ is going to make a huge difference!
french: Mais ta présence et le fait que tu gères $[farm_name]$ vont faire une grosse différence !
russian: Но твоя работа на ферме $«[farm_name]»$ изменит очень многое!
bulgarian: But having you here to run $[farm_name]$ is going to make a huge difference!

english: It's been harder to get the ingredients we need to keep the Inn running since the earthquake...
french: Depuis le tremblement de terre, il est plus difficile de trouver les ingrédients dont on a besoin pour faire tourner l'auberge...
russian: После землетрясения стало сложнее доставать продукты, нужные, чтобы трактир работал...
bulgarian: It's been harder to get the ingredients we need to keep the Inn running since the earthquake...

english: I'm sure you'll get settled in no time.
bulgarian: I'm sure you'll get settled in no time.

english: Hey! Let me know if you need anything.
french: Bonjour ! Alors, tu aimes la ville jusqu'à maintenant ? Si tu as besoin de quelque chose, tu n'as qu'à le dire !
russian: Приветик! Как тебе город? Скажи, если что-то понадобится.
bulgarian: Hey! Let me know if you need anything.

english: We used to be a much livelier town back before the earthquake...
french: La ville était bien plus animée avant le tremblement de terre...
russian: Раньше, до землетрясения, у нас было намного оживлённее...
bulgarian: We used to be a much livelier town back before the earthquake...

english: I hope you're the first of many.
french: J'espère que tu n'es que <she>la première</she><he>le premier</he><they>læ premier·ère</they> d'une longue série.
russian:
Надеюсь, ты

первые

перваяпервыйпервое из многих.
bulgarian: I hope you're the first of many.

english: It's nice to have someone new in town.
french: C'est sympa voir de nouvelles têtes arriver en ville.
russian: Приятно, что в город приходят новые люди.
bulgarian: It's nice to have someone new in town.

english: It's strange, he always comes back from his supply runs with extra unmarked crates... stuff we didn't even order.
french: C'est bizarre, il revient toujours de ses expéditions avec des caisses en plus, sans aucune inscription... Des marchandises que nous n'avons pas commandées, en plus.
russian: Странное дело: каждый раз, когда он ходит за поставками, он приносит какие-то неподписанные ящики... И там вещи, которые мы даже не заказывали.
bulgarian: It's strange, he always comes back from his supply runs with extra unmarked crates... stuff we didn't even order.

english: Hmmm.
french: Hmm.
russian: Хммм.
bulgarian: Hmmm.

russian: У нас дома замечательная атмосфера.

french: Ça m'ennuie de réclamer, mais si mes affaires étaient installées ici, je me sentirais davantage chez moi !
russian: Мне неудобно тебя просить, но с ними я точно смогу чувствовать себя как дома!
bulgarian: I hate to ask, but having my things set up in the house would make it feel more like home!

english: Can you make sure all my stuff has a place to go in the house?
french: Tu pourrais faire en sorte que tous mes meubles trouvent une place dans la maison ?
russian: Ты можешь подыскать в доме место для моих вещей?
bulgarian: Can you make sure all my stuff has a place to go in the house?

english: All I know for sure is that you were in it...
french: Tout ce que je sais, c'est que tu étais dedans...
russian:
Только знаю, что в нём

былабылбыло ты...

english: Hehe!
french: Hi hi !
russian: Хи-хи!
bulgarian: Hehe!

english: I had such an interesting dream last night, but now I can hardly remember it!
french: J'ai fait un rêve très intéressant la nuit dernière, mais je n'arrive plus à m'en rappeler !
russian: Мне снился такой интересный сон, но сейчас я уже почти ничего не помню!
bulgarian: I had such an interesting dream last night, but now I can hardly remember it!

english: I'm sure you'll be glad to hear that my plans tonight are spending lots of time with you!
french: Je suis sûre que ça te fera plaisir de savoir que ce soir, j'ai prévu de passer plein de temps avec toi !
russian: Спешу тебя обрадовать: в мои планы на вечер входит провести его с тобой!
bulgarian: I'm sure you'll be glad to hear that my plans tonight are spending lots of time with you!

english: Welcome home, [Ari]!
french: Bienvenue à la maison, [Ari] !
russian: С возвращением, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Welcome home, [Ari]!

english: Nothing like wrapping up my day, knowing I'll be in your arms soon.
french: Rien de tel pour finir une journée en beauté que de savoir que je serai bientôt dans tes bras.
russian: Приятно завершать день, зная, что скоро буду лежать в твоих объятиях.
bulgarian: Nothing like wrapping up my day, knowing I'll be in your arms soon.

english: There you are, [Ari]!
french: Te voilà, [Ari] !
russian: А вот и [Ari]!
bulgarian: There you are, [Ari]!

english: I can't wait to hear all about it!
french: J'ai hâte que tu me racontes tout !
russian: Я всё хочу услышать в подробностях!
bulgarian: I can't wait to hear all about it!

english: How was your day, [Ari]?
french: Comment s'est passée ta journée, [Ari] ?
russian: Как прошёл день, [Ari]?
bulgarian: How was your day, [Ari]?

english: Hehe, love you.
french: Hi hi, je t'aime.
russian: Хи-хи, люблю тебя.
bulgarian: Hehe, love you.

english: There you are, [Ari]! Don't I get a kiss?
french: Te voilà, [Ari] ! Je n'ai pas droit à un bisou ?
russian: А вот и [Ari]! Ты же не оставишь меня без поцелуя?
bulgarian: There you are, [Ari]! Don't I get a kiss?

english: I keep getting distracted thinking of new dishes to cook.
french: Je n'arrête pas d'être distraite par toutes mes idées de nouveaux plats à cuisiner.
russian: У меня вся голова забита идеями для новых блюд.
bulgarian: I keep getting distracted thinking of new dishes to cook.

english: There's so much fresh produce in the fall!
french: Il y a tellement de produits frais, en automne !
russian: Осенью так много свежих фруктов и овощей!
bulgarian: There's so much fresh produce in the fall!

english: Still, I think my favorite thing is that it's the time for fresh =Garlic=!
french: Il n'empêche, je crois que ce que je préfère, c'est que c'est la saison de l'=ail= frais !
russian: Но для меня самое главное, что это сезон свежего =чеснока=!
bulgarian: Still, I think my favorite thing is that it's the time for fresh =Garlic=!

english: There's so much to love about fall, isn't there?
french: Il y a tellement de choses que j'adore, en automne !
russian: Есть множество причин любить осень.
bulgarian: There's so much to love about fall, isn't there?

english: No time to slack off in the fall, there's just too much to do!
french: L'automne n'est pas une saison pour tirer au flanc, il y a bien trop à faire !
russian: Осенью прохлаждаться некогда, кругом дела!
bulgarian: No time to slack off in the fall, there's just too much to do!

english: I love fall, don't you?
french: J'adore l'automne, pas toi ?
russian: Обожаю осень. Ты тоже?
bulgarian: I love fall, don't you?

english: The produce is top notch this time of year, and the customers all have big appetites!
french: Les produits sont de première qualité, à cette époque de l'année, et les clients ont tous un gros appétit !
russian: В это время года ингредиенты самые свежие, а у клиентов большие аппетиты!
bulgarian: The produce is top notch this time of year, and the customers all have big appetites!

english: Did you sleep well?
french: Tu as bien dormi ?
russian: Как тебе спалось?
bulgarian: Did you sleep well?

english: Gooood morning, [Ari]!
french: Booonjour, [Ari] !
russian: До-о-оброе утро, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Gooood morning, [Ari]!

english: I can tell it's going to be a great one, can't you?
french: Je sens que ça va être une super journée, tu ne crois pas ?
russian: Думаю, сегодня нас ждёт хороший день.
bulgarian: I can tell it's going to be a great one, can't you?

english: Morning!
french: Bonjour !
russian: Утречка!
bulgarian: Morning!

english: Let's get all snuggled up and enjoy the sound of the rain.
french: Installons-nous confortablement et savourons le bruit de la pluie.
russian: Давай закутаемся поближе и будет слушать шум дождя.
bulgarian: Let's get all snuggled up and enjoy the sound of the rain.

english: It's so good to be home!
french: C'est tellement agréable d'être à la maison !
russian: Как хорошо наконец оказаться дома!
bulgarian: It's so good to be home!

english: Should be a fun day!
french: On devrait passer une bonne journée !
russian: Значит, день будет весёлый!
bulgarian: Should be a fun day!

english: The Inn is always so full when it rains...
french: L'auberge est toujours pleine à craquer quand il pleut...
russian: В дождливые дни в Трактире всегда полно народу...
bulgarian: The Inn is always so full when it rains...

english: It's a good excuse to play around a little with a new coffee blend!
french: C'est l'excuse parfaite pour expérimenter un nouveau mélange de café !
russian: Хороший повод протестировать новую кофейную смесь!
bulgarian: It's a good excuse to play around a little with a new coffee blend!

english: Feeling pretty sleepy this morning...
french: Je me sens tout endormie, ce matin...
russian: Сегодня я с самого утра такая сонная...
bulgarian: Feeling pretty sleepy this morning...

english: I could go for a hot drink, how about you?
french: J'ai assez envie d'une boisson chaude, et toi ?
russian: Я бы выпила чего-нибудь горяченького, а ты?
bulgarian: I could go for a hot drink, how about you?

english: Brr, I'm chilled through.
french: Brrr, je suis frigorifiée.
russian: Брр, я насквозь продрогла.
bulgarian: Brr, I'm chilled through.

english: Feels like a perfect day to make a big pot of curry to keep folks warm!
french: J'ai l'impression que c'est la journée idéale pour préparer une grosse marmite de curry qui réchauffera tout le monde !
russian: Самый подходящий день, чтобы сделать большой котёл карри и всех согреть!
bulgarian: Feels like a perfect day to make a big pot of curry to keep folks warm!

english: Would you look at that snow!
french: Regarde-moi un peu toute cette neige !
russian: Смотри, какой снег!
bulgarian: Would you look at that snow!

english: Be sure to stop by the Inn if you have the chance, okay?
french: Arrête-toi à l'auberge si tu en as l'occasion, surtout, d'accord ?
russian: Заходи ко мне в трактир, если будет время!
bulgarian: Be sure to stop by the Inn if you have the chance, okay?

english: Lots to do today...
french: J'ai beaucoup à faire, aujourd'hui...
russian: Много дел сегодня...
bulgarian: Lots to do today...

english: Spring is always so busy!
french: Il y a toujours tellement de choses à faire, au printemps !
russian: Весна — такое суетливое время года!
bulgarian: Spring is always so busy!

english: Felt like I was playing catch up all day...
french: J'ai eu l'impression de courir après le temps toute la journée...
russian: Я, кажется, весь день чё-то не успеваю...
bulgarian: Felt like I was playing catch up all day...

english: Everywhere I've been today I could smell the flowers!
french: Partout où je suis allée aujourd'hui, je pouvais sentir le parfum des fleurs !
russian: Везде, куда ни пойду, стоит аромат цветов!
bulgarian: Everywhere I've been today I could smell the flowers!

english: Isn't springtime in Mistria lovely?
french: Est-ce que le printemps n'est pas magnifique, à Mistria ?
russian: Как хорошо в Мистрии весной!
bulgarian: Isn't springtime in Mistria lovely?

english: All the spring rain makes the roads into Mistria a slog. Nothing to be done about it but make do.
french: Avec toute la pluie qui tombe à Mistria au printemps, circuler sur les routes est une galère. Il faut faire avec, on n'a pas le choix.
russian: Из-за весенних дождей на мистрийских дорогах стоит слякоть. Ничего не поделать, остаётся только ждать.
bulgarian: All the spring rain makes the roads into Mistria a slog. Nothing to be done about it but make do.

english: Our latest delivery to the Inn is late...
french: Notre dernière livraison pour l'auberge est en retard...
russian: К нам в трактир всё никак не доедет заказ...
bulgarian: Our latest delivery to the Inn is late...

english: Let's try and make the most of it.
french: Essayons d'en profiter au maximum.
russian: Надо этим воспользоваться и успеть побольше дел.
bulgarian: Let's try and make the most of it.

english: Isn't this spring weather just perfect?
french: Est-ce que cette météo printanière n'est pas idéale ?
russian: Весной просто шикарная погода!
bulgarian: Isn't this spring weather just perfect?

english: How would you feel about an =Ice Cream Sundae= for dinner?
french: Que dirais-tu d'une =coupe de crème glacée=, pour le dîner ?
russian: Что думаешь насчёт ужина с =мороженым «сандей»=?
bulgarian: How would you feel about an =Ice Cream Sundae= for dinner?

english: I was hoping the weather was going to cool off, but it's just getting hotter!
french: J'espérais que les températures se rafraîchiraient, mais il fait de plus en plus chaud !
russian: Я надеялась, что температура спадёт, но становится только жарче!
bulgarian: I was hoping the weather was going to cool off, but it's just getting hotter!

english: We should take advantage of this nice weather and go together sometime!
french: On devrait profiter du beau temps pour y aller ensemble, un de ces jours !
russian: Надо пользоваться погодой и вместе туда сходить!
bulgarian: We should take advantage of this nice weather and go together sometime!

english: I'm so glad Mistria has a beach.
french: Heureusement qu'il y a la plage à Mistria.
russian: Как я рада, что в Мистрии есть пляж.
bulgarian: I'm so glad Mistria has a beach.

english: Hopefully tonight's a little cooler.
french: Heureusement, les températures ont un peu baissé, ce soir.
russian: Надеюсь, сегодня будет попрохладнее.
bulgarian: Hopefully tonight's a little cooler.

english: It's so hard to get a good night's sleep in this heat.
french: C'est tellement dur de faire une bonne nuit de sommeil avec cette chaleur.
russian: В такую жару даже выспаться как следует трудно.
bulgarian: It's so hard to get a good night's sleep in this heat.

english: I'm going to get the Dragonguard to help me make ice cream.
french: Je vais embaucher la Garde des dragons pour qu'ils m'aident à faire de la crème glacée.
russian: Попрошу Драконью стражу помочь мне готовить мороженое.
bulgarian: I'm going to get the Dragonguard to help me make ice cream.

english: Gonna be a scorcher today!
french: On va avoir une journée caniculaire !
russian: Сегодня будет жарища!
bulgarian: Gonna be a scorcher today!

english: I lost count of the number of times we needed to mop.
french: J'ai arrêté de compter le nombre de fois où on a dû passer la serpillière.
russian: Мы так часто мыли полы, что я сбилась со счёта.
bulgarian: I lost count of the number of times we needed to mop.

english: What a day! Everyone kept tracking snow into the Inn.
french: Quelle journée ! Tout le monde laissait des traces pleines de neige, dans l'auberge.
russian: Ну и денёк! Каждый гость заносил в трактир кучу снега.
bulgarian: What a day! Everyone kept tracking snow into the Inn.

english: Let's call it early tonight, okay?
french: Allons nous coucher tôt, ce soir, d'accord ?
russian: Давай сегодня закончим пораньше?
bulgarian: Let's call it early tonight, okay?

english: With the sun down, it's getting even colder out.
french: Une fois le soleil couché, il fait encore plus froid, dehors.
russian: С заходом солнца стало ещё холоднее.
bulgarian: With the sun down, it's getting even colder out.

english: I'll just have to do my best with what's available.
french: Je vais devoir faire au mieux avec ce qui est disponible.
russian: Приходится выдумывать из того, что есть.
bulgarian: I'll just have to do my best with what's available.

english: It gets harder to find good quality ingredients in the winter.
french: C'est plus difficile de trouver des ingrédients de bonne qualité, en hiver.
russian: Зимой труднее найти качественные ингредиенты.
bulgarian: It gets harder to find good quality ingredients in the winter.

english: Better look out, I heard Luc and Maple were planning a snowball fight.
french: Méfie-toi, j'ai entendu dire que Luc et Maple prévoyaient de faire une bataille de boules de neige.
russian: Я слышала, Люк и Мэйпл затеяли играть в снежки. Смотри не попадись между ними!
bulgarian: Better look out, I heard Luc and Maple were planning a snowball fight.

english: Isn't the air brisk today?
french: L'air est frisquet aujourd'hui, non ?
russian: Воздух сегодня будто хрустит!
bulgarian: Isn't the air brisk today?

english: I need to find a better thesaurus, this one doesn't have enough alternatives for the word "delicious".
french: Il faut que je trouve un meilleur dictionnaire des synonymes, celui-ci n'a pas suffisamment d'alternatives au mot « délicieux ».
russian: Мне нужен хороший словарь. В этом недостаточно синонимов к слову «вкусный».
bulgarian: I need to find a better thesaurus, this one doesn't have enough alternatives for the word "delicious".

english: Hey, [Ari]! Just working on my cookbook.
french: Salut, [Ari] ! Je travaille sur mon livre de recettes.
russian: Привет, [Ari]! Я пишу книгу рецептов.
bulgarian: Hey, [Ari]! Just working on my cookbook.

english: It'd be fun to see what food trends are popular there!
french: Ce serait drôle d'aller découvrir quelles sont les nouvelles tendances culinaires, là-bas !
russian: Интересно посмотреть, какие блюда там сейчас в моде!
bulgarian: It'd be fun to see what food trends are popular there!

english: We should plan a trip to the Capital sometime.
french: On devrait se prévoir un voyage à la capitale, à l'occasion.
russian: Нам пора запланировать поездку в столицу.
bulgarian: We should plan a trip to the Capital sometime.

english: But I don't think the author actually tried any of these recipes, they're terrible.
french: Mais je crois que l'auteur n'a jamais vraiment goûté aucune de ses recettes, elles sont catastrophiques.
russian: Кажется, авторы сами не пробовали своих рецептов. Они просто ужасные.
bulgarian: But I don't think the author actually tried any of these recipes, they're terrible.

english: So I thought I'd see if I can improve them!
french: Alors, je me suis dit que j'allais les réécrire !
russian: Так что я решила их слегка переписать!
bulgarian: So I thought I'd see if I can improve them!

english: I picked up a cookbook for "healthly" eating.
french: J'ai choisi un livre de cuisine qui propose des recettes « saines ».
russian: Я нашла книгу о так называемом «здоровом питании».
bulgarian: I picked up a cookbook for "healthly" eating.

english: I might even have a little nap!
french: Je pourrais même faire une petite sieste !
russian: Может, я даже немного вздремну!
bulgarian: I might even have a little nap!

english: Ahh, there's nothing better than a comfy chair.
french: Ah, rien ne vaut un fauteuil confortable.
russian: Ах, до чего уютно бывает раскинуться в кресле.
bulgarian: Ahh, there's nothing better than a comfy chair.

english: It's a fantasy novel about a land with talking dragons!
french: C'est un roman de fantasy qui parle d'une terre où vivent des dragons qui parlent !
russian: Это фантастический роман про землю говорящих драконов!
bulgarian: It's a fantasy novel about a land with talking dragons!

english: Huh... that's actually not that fantastical is it?
french: Euh... Ça n'est pas si fantastique que ça, en réalité, non ?
russian: Хм... Звучит не так уж и фантастично.
bulgarian: Huh... that's actually not that fantastical is it?

english: [Ari]! Someone left this book behind at the Inn.
french: [Ari] ! Quelqu'un a oublié ce livre, à l'auberge.
russian: [Ari]! Кто-то оставил в трактире эту книгу.
bulgarian: [Ari]! Someone left this book behind at the Inn.

english: I can go on a grand adventure while being cozy at home!
french: Je peux m'embarquer dans une aventure épique tout en restant bien confortablement chez moi !
russian: Я могу отправиться странствовать в поисках приключений, сидя дома в уютном кресле.
bulgarian: I can go on a grand adventure while being cozy at home!

english: There really isn't much better than a good book, is there?
french: Il n'existe quand même pas grand-chose de mieux qu'un bon livre, non ?
russian: Как же я люблю хорошие книги!
bulgarian: There really isn't much better than a good book, is there?

english: Good, right?
french: C'est bon, hein ?
russian: Вкусно?
bulgarian: Good, right?

english: I think this might be one for my cookbook!
french: Je crois que je vais mettre ça dans mon livre de recettes !
russian: Думаю, этот рецепт я запишу в кулинарную книгу.
bulgarian: I think this might be one for my cookbook!

english: Perfect timing! Here, try this.
french: Tu tombes à pic ! Tiens, goûte ça.
russian: Ты как раз вовремя! Вот, попробуй.
bulgarian: Perfect timing! Here, try this.

english: Of course, I suppose we could just have it for dinner if it works out!
french: Évidemment, ça pourrait aussi être notre repas de ce soir !
russian: Хотя, может, его мы и отведаем на ужин!
bulgarian: Of course, I suppose we could just have it for dinner if it works out!

french: On dînera peut-être un peu tard, je dois finir de tester cette nouvelle recette...
russian: Ужин сегодня задерживается, хочу доделать один рецепт на пробу...
bulgarian: Dinner might be late tonight, I gotta finish making this new test recipe...

french: Quand j'étais à l'auberge, si ce que je préparais commençait à sentir bon, la moitié des clients voulait goûter !
russian: А в трактире как только у тебя блюдо начнёт вкусно пахнуть, половина гостей сразу захочет попробовать кусочек!
bulgarian: Back at the Inn, if anything I was making started smelling nice, half the patrons would want a bite!

english: Now I just need to worry about keeping an extra bite for you!
french: Maintenant, je dois seulement veiller à t'en garder un peu !
russian: Теперь самый вкусный кусочек я могу откладывать только для тебя!
bulgarian: Now I just need to worry about keeping an extra bite for you!

english: It's so relaxing, cooking here at home.
french: C'est tellement relaxant de cuisiner ici, à la maison.
russian: Я могу по-настоящему расслабиться, когда готовлю дома.
bulgarian: It's so relaxing, cooking here at home.

english: I just know our animals will take home a prize!
bulgarian: I just know our animals will take home a prize!

bulgarian: Today's the $Animal Festival$! Are you ready?

bulgarian: I can't wait to see how many $Queen Berries$ have been collected... I think this year's going to be amazing!

english: And of course, if you want to dance later... I'm all yours.
bulgarian: And of course, if you want to dance later... I'm all yours.

english: Good morning and happy $Harvest Festival$!
bulgarian: Good morning and happy $Harvest Festival$!

english: I can't wait to watch the stars with you!
bulgarian: I can't wait to watch the stars with you!

english: Morning! The weather is supposed to be perfect for the $Shooting Star Festival$ tonight.
bulgarian: Morning! The weather is supposed to be perfect for the $Shooting Star Festival$ tonight.

english: Do you think you have enough $Breath of Spring$ to bring home the gold this year?
bulgarian: Do you think you have enough $Breath of Spring$ to bring home the gold this year?

english: I'll be cheering for you!
bulgarian: I'll be cheering for you!

english: Morning, [Ari]! Excited for the $Spring Festival$?
bulgarian: Morning, [Ari]! Excited for the $Spring Festival$?

english: I think I might head out to the Saturday Market later... Darcy and I have an appointment to talk shop!
bulgarian: I think I might head out to the Saturday Market later... Darcy and I have an appointment to talk shop!
