french: Pendant toute mon enfance, mes parents m'ont raconté des histoires sur l'époque où ils tournaient avec leur groupe.
russian: Когда я была маленькая, родители рассказывали мне истории из своих музыкальных путешествий.
bulgarian: Growing up, my parents always told me stories from their days as traveling musicians.

english: They'd move from town to town, playing shows at each inn as they went.
french: Ils allaient de ville en ville et donnaient des concerts dans les auberges.
russian: Они ездили из города в город и выступали в каждом встречном трактире.
bulgarian: They'd move from town to town, playing shows at each inn as they went.

english: Some inns were smaller and more run down than others...
french: Elles n'étaient pas toujours très grandes ou en très bon état.
russian: Иногда трактиры попадались небольшие и ветхие...
bulgarian: Some inns were smaller and more run down than others...

english: But even in the poorest villages, there would always be a smiling face and a hot meal waiting to welcome them.
french: Mais même dans les villages les plus pauvres, on les accueillait toujours avec un sourire et un bon repas chaud.
russian: Но даже в самых бедных деревнях их встречали улыбкой и горячим ужином.
bulgarian: But even in the poorest villages, there would always be a smiling face and a hot meal waiting to welcome them.

english: Warming their weary hearts and stomachs after a long day on the road.
french: Ça leur réchauffait le cœur et le ventre après une longue journée sur la route.
russian: Это помогало им согреть сердце и живот после долгого дня в пути.
bulgarian: Warming their weary hearts and stomachs after a long day on the road.

english: I think maybe that's what inspired my love for cooking...
french: C'est peut-être pour ça que j'aime autant la cuisine...
russian: Я думаю, возможно, это вдохновило меня полюбить кулинарию...
bulgarian: I think maybe that's what inspired my love for cooking...

english: It's such a tangible way of showing care for another person.
french: C'est une manière si concrète de prendre soin des autres.
russian: Это такой ощутимый способ проявить заботу о человеке.
bulgarian: It's such a tangible way of showing care for another person.

english: I hope the Sleeping Dragon Inn will always be a place that a traveler can call home, if even just for a night.
french: J'espère que l'auberge du Dragon qui dort sera toujours un lieu où les voyageurs se sentiront chez eux, même si ce n'est qu'une nuit.
russian: Надеюсь, в трактире «Спящий дракон» путешественники всегда смогут найти свой дом, пускай и на одну ночь.
bulgarian: I hope the Sleeping Dragon Inn will always be a place that a traveler can call home, if even just for a night.

english: Want to hear a secret, [Ari]?
french: Tu veux que je te dise un secret, [Ari] ?
russian: Хочешь, скажу кое-что по секрету, [Ari]?
bulgarian: Want to hear a secret, [Ari]?

english: It's amazing to be surrounded by folks who look out for you.
french: C'est fantastique d'être entourée de personnes qui prennent soin de toi.
russian: Это потрясающе, когда все люди вокруг о тебе заботятся.
bulgarian: It's amazing to be surrounded by folks who look out for you.

english: And you can taste test for me anytime!
french: Et tu pourras goûter mes plats à tout instant !
russian: А ты можешь дегустировать для меня, когда захочешь!
bulgarian: And you can taste test for me anytime!

english: But I didn't realize what a difference it would make to have someone truly share in my dreams...
french: Mais je ne pensais pas qu'avoir à mes côtés une personne qui partage vraiment mes rêves changerait à ce point les choses...
russian: Но я и не знала, как важно, оказывается, иметь человека, с которым я могу разделить свои мечты...
bulgarian: But I didn't realize what a difference it would make to have someone truly share in my dreams...

english: Not until you moved to town.
french: Jusqu'à ton arrivée en ville.
russian:
Пока ты не

приехали

приехалаприехалприехало к нам в город.
bulgarian: Not until you moved to town.

english: It makes me so happy!
french: Et j'en suis très heureuse !
russian: Я так счастлива!
bulgarian: It makes me so happy!

english: Me too! I'll always enjoy cooking!
french: Moi aussi ! J'aimerai toujours cuisiner !
russian: Я тоже! Никогда не устану готовить!
bulgarian: Me too! I'll always enjoy cooking!

english: Me too! I'll always enjoy eating your food!
french: Moi aussi ! J'aimerai toujours déguster tes petits plats !
russian: Я тоже! Никогда не устану есть твою еду!
bulgarian: Me too! I'll always enjoy eating your food!

english: I'm so glad [Ari]!
french: Je suis si contente, [Ari] !
russian: Как я рада, [Ari]!
bulgarian: I'm so glad [Ari]!

english: Let's keep helping each other get better and better.
french: On va s'entraider pour faire toujours mieux.
russian: Давай будем помогать друг другу становиться лучше.
bulgarian: Let's keep helping each other get better and better.

english: I'll taste test for you anytime you need it!
french: Je me ferai un plaisir de goûter tes préparations !
russian: Я могу для тебя дегустировать, когда захочешь!
bulgarian: I'll taste test for you anytime you need it!

english: I'm so glad [Ari]!
french: Je suis si contente, [Ari] !
russian: Как я рада, [Ari]!
bulgarian: I'm so glad [Ari]!

english: I'm so glad [Ari]!
french: Je suis si contente, [Ari] !
russian: Как я рада, [Ari]!
bulgarian: I'm so glad [Ari]!

english: I promise I'll keep working hard at it.
french: C'est promis. Je continuerai à cuisiner de tout mon cœur.
russian: Обещаю, что продолжу развивать свои навыки!
bulgarian: I promise I'll keep working hard at it.

english: I promise I'll keep working hard at it.
french: C'est promis. Je continuerai à cuisiner de tout mon cœur.
russian: Обещаю, что продолжу развивать свои навыки!
bulgarian: I promise I'll keep working hard at it.

english: I loved growing up in a cozy little place like Mistria.
french: J'ai adoré grandir dans une petite ville tranquille comme Mistria.
russian: В таком маленьком уютном местечке, как Мистрия, у меня было счастливое детство.
bulgarian: I loved growing up in a cozy little place like Mistria.

english: It's funny... I was just thinking about the first time you came to the Inn.
french: C'est drôle... Je repensais à ta première visite à l'auberge.
russian:
Забавно... Я как раз вспоминала тот раз, когда ты впервые

пришли

пришлапришёлпришло в трактир.
bulgarian: It's funny... I was just thinking about the first time you came to the Inn.

english: And that first Friday night you joined the festivities.
french: À la première soirée du vendredi que tu as passée avec nous.
russian:
И первую пятницу, когда ты

присоединились

присоединиласьприсоединилсяприсоединилось к веселью.
bulgarian: And that first Friday night you joined the festivities.

english: It all feels so long ago, doesn't it? It's hard to imagine this place without you.
french: J'ai l'impression que c'était il y a une éternité. J'ai du mal à imaginer cet endroit sans toi.
russian: Кажется, это было так давно. Трудно представить это место без тебя.
bulgarian: It all feels so long ago, doesn't it? It's hard to imagine this place without you.

english: Here, let me mix you up something tasty... for old time's sake!
french: Laisse-moi te préparer un petit quelque chose... en souvenir du temps qui passe !
russian: Давай налью тебе что-нибудь вкусненькое... За добрую память!
bulgarian: Here, let me mix you up something tasty... for old time's sake!

english: Hey [Ari]!
french: Salut, [Ari] !
russian: Привет, [Ari]!
bulgarian: Hey [Ari]!

english: Now Mines forage is always in stock, and you're regularly finding exciting new ingredients, too!
french: Maintenant, on a refait les réserves et tu nous trouves régulièrement de nouveaux ingrédients.
russian: Теперь растения из шахт всегда в наличии. К тому же ты постоянно находишь новые необычные ингредиенты!
bulgarian: Now Mines forage is always in stock, and you're regularly finding exciting new ingredients, too!

english: I'm so happy that we've reconnected with that aspect of our culinary tradition.
french: Je suis si contente qu'on ait pu renouer avec cette facette de nos traditions culinaires.
russian: Я так рада, что мы не утратили эту часть наших кулинарных традиций.
bulgarian: I'm so happy that we've reconnected with that aspect of our culinary tradition.

english: And it's been fun trying my hand at these old recipes again. Like this one!
french: En plus, je m'amuse comme une folle à tester ces vieilles recettes. Comme celle-ci !
russian: А ещё увлекательно воссоздавать эти старые рецепты. Вот этот, например!
bulgarian: And it's been fun trying my hand at these old recipes again. Like this one!

english: It's hard to believe how long we went without access to ingredients from the Mines, after the earthquake.
french: Difficile d'imaginer que suite au tremblement de terre, on ait été si longtemps privés de produits provenant des mines.
russian: Трудно представить, как долго нам приходилось обходиться без ингредиентов из шахт из-за землетрясения.
bulgarian: It's hard to believe how long we went without access to ingredients from the Mines, after the earthquake.

english: Mom told me it was named by her great great grandpa.
french: Maman m'a dit que c'était en hommage à son arrière-grand-père.
russian: Мама говорит, что его назвал её прапрапрадед.
bulgarian: Mom told me it was named by her great great grandpa.

english: But it's been generations, so I'm sure the story has changed over the years.
french: Mais cela remonte à quelques générations. L'histoire a dû changer au fil des années.
russian: Но с тех пор сменилось несколько поколений — наверняка рассказ за эти годы успел измениться.
bulgarian: But it's been generations, so I'm sure the story has changed over the years.

english: Even if it turns out it wasn't true... it's fun to think about, isn't it?
french: Et même si tout était inventé... c'est amusant comme idée, non ?
russian: Даже если окажется, что это неправда... Всё равно приятно об этом думать.
bulgarian: Even if it turns out it wasn't true... it's fun to think about, isn't it?

english: Wouldn't that be amazing?
french: Ce serait incroyable, non ?
russian: Вот бы здорово было, правда?
bulgarian: Wouldn't that be amazing?

english: Some of the forest around Mistria is so impenetrable... it really feels like anything could be out there.
french: La forêt entourant Mistria est tellement dense. On a l'impression qu'elle pourrait abriter tout et n'importe quoi.
russian: Вокруг Мистрии есть совершенно неплроходимые леса... Кажется, будто в них правда может скрываться что угодно.
bulgarian: Some of the forest around Mistria is so impenetrable... it really feels like anything could be out there.

english: It's been generations, so I'm sure the story has changed over the years. Maybe it never even happened!
french: Ça remonte à quelques générations. Je suis sûre que l'histoire a dû changer au fil des années. Ce n'est peut-être même jamais arrivé !
russian: Но с тех пор сменилось несколько поколений — наверняка рассказ за эти годы успел измениться. Может, этого и не было никогда!
bulgarian: It's been generations, so I'm sure the story has changed over the years. Maybe it never even happened!

english: Or maybe there's still a slumbering dragon out there even now!
french: Ou peut-être qu'un dragon dort quelque part dans la forêt en ce moment même !
russian: А может, где-то там до сих пор спит дракон!
bulgarian: Or maybe there's still a slumbering dragon out there even now!

english: The story goes that he visited the $Deep Woods$ one day, and got lost after he strayed from his usual path.
french: L'histoire veut qu'un jour, il soit allé se promener à $Boissombre$ et qu'il se soit perdu après s'être écarté du sentier.
russian: По её словам, однажды он шёл по $Глубокой чаще$, сошёл с привычной дороги и заблудился.
bulgarian: The story goes that he visited the $Deep Woods$ one day, and got lost after he strayed from his usual path.

english: He wandered among dense trees for hours, searching for the path home.
french: Il aurait erré des heures durant dans des sous-bois épais, à essayer de retrouver son chemin.
russian: Он несколько часов бродил среди густых деревьев в поисках тропинки к дому.
bulgarian: He wandered among dense trees for hours, searching for the path home.

english: Finally, he came across some old ruins in a clearing. The sun was setting, so he decided to shelter there until the next day.
french: Finalement, il serait arrivé à un amas de ruines dans une clairière. Le soleil étant près de se coucher, il aurait décidé de s'y abriter pour la nuit.
russian: Наконец он вышел к поляне со старинными руинами. Солнце уже садилось, и он решил там переночевать.
bulgarian: Finally, he came across some old ruins in a clearing. The sun was setting, so he decided to shelter there until the next day.

english: That night, he dreamed of a huge sleeping dragon. It didn't speak to him, but it seemed to be pointing him home.
french: Cette nuit-là, il aurait rêvé d'un immense dragon endormi. Celui-ci n'aurait pas prononcé un mot, mais il semblait lui indiquer la direction de sa maison.
russian: В ту ночь ему приснился огромный спящий дракон. Он ничего не говорил, но как будто указывал ему дорогу домой.
bulgarian: That night, he dreamed of a huge sleeping dragon. It didn't speak to him, but it seemed to be pointing him home.

english: The next morning, he walked in the direction the dragon had been facing, and made it home safely.
french: Le lendemain matin, il aurait pris la direction vers laquelle le dragon était tourné et il serait rentré chez lui sans encombre.
russian: На следующее утро он пошёл в направлении, куда указывала голова дракона, и вернулся домой невредим.
bulgarian: The next morning, he walked in the direction the dragon had been facing, and made it home safely.

english: He named the Inn after that dream dragon who saved him!
french: Il aurait donc nommé son auberge en hommage au dragon du rêve qui l'avait sauvé.
russian: И назвал трактир в честь дракона, который спас его во сне!
bulgarian: He named the Inn after that dream dragon who saved him!

english: Wow! Do you think that really happened?
french: Waouh ! Tu crois que c'est vraiment arrivé ?
russian: Ух ты! Ты веришь, что так правда было?
bulgarian: Wow! Do you think that really happened?

english: Do you think it was a real dragon?
french: Tu crois que c'était un vrai dragon ?
russian: Ты думаешь, это был настоящий дракон?
bulgarian: Do you think it was a real dragon?

english: I like to think so!
french: J'aime me dire que oui !
russian: Мне хочется верить!
bulgarian: I like to think so!

english: Some of the forest around Mistria is so impenetrable... it really feels like anything could be out there.
french: La forêt entourant Mistria est tellement dense. On a l'impression qu'elle pourrait abriter tout et n'importe quoi.
russian: Вокруг Мистрии есть совершенно непроходимые леса... Кажется, будто в них правда может скрываться что угодно.
bulgarian: Some of the forest around Mistria is so impenetrable... it really feels like anything could be out there.

english: Have I ever told you how the Sleeping Dragon Inn got its name?
french: Je t'ai déjà raconté comment l'auberge du Dragon qui dort a hérité de ce nom ?
russian: Я тебе рассказывала, почему трактир «Спящий дракон» так называется?
bulgarian: Have I ever told you how the Sleeping Dragon Inn got its name?

english: This kind of weather always makes me want to curl up by the hearth with snacks and a book.
french: Quand il fait ce temps-là, je n'ai qu'une envie : m'installer au coin du feu avec un bon livre et de quoi grignoter.
russian: В такую погоду мне хочется взять книжку и что-нибудь перекусить и закутаться в плед у печки.
bulgarian: This kind of weather always makes me want to curl up by the hearth with snacks and a book.

english: If you bring the book, I'll bring the snacks!
french: Si tu t'occupes du livre, j'apporte de quoi grignoter !
russian: Если принесёшь книгу, перекус я возьму на себя!
bulgarian: If you bring the book, I'll bring the snacks!

english: I like something with lots of adventure... Ooh, and at least two sword fights!
french: J'aime les histoires pleines d'aventure... Oh, et avec au moins deux combats à l'épée !
russian: Мне нравятся истории о приключениях... О, и хотя бы две дуэли на мечах!
bulgarian: I like something with lots of adventure... Ooh, and at least two sword fights!

english: Isn't the sound of the rain so dreamy?
french: Le bruit de la pluie a toujours un effet si apaisant.
russian: Звук дождя такой убаюкивающий, правда?
bulgarian: Isn't the sound of the rain so dreamy?

english: That's because I'm the one who picked them!
french: Parce que c'est moi qui les ai choisis !
russian: Это потому что я их выбирала!
bulgarian: That's because I'm the one who picked them!

english: They reminded me of the covers of my favorite adventure novels.
french: Ils me rappelaient les couvertures de mes romans d'aventures préférés.
russian: Они напоминают обложки моих любимых приключенческих романов.
bulgarian: They reminded me of the covers of my favorite adventure novels.

english: There was a bit of debate in the family over the dragons in the paintings, though.
french: Mais toute la famille a beaucoup discuté des dragons représentés.
russian: Правда, у нас в семье возникло небольшое недопонимание в связи с драконом.
bulgarian: There was a bit of debate in the family over the dragons in the paintings, though.

english: While it's true that our namesake dragon is sleeping... I think the paintings look more exciting, showing them awake.
french: C'est vrai que le dragon de notre auberge dort... Je trouve quand même que les tableaux sont plus vivants s'ils sont réveillés.
russian: Хотя наш трактир назван всё-таки в честь спящего дракона... По-моему, эти картины, показывающие его бодрствующим, выглядят более захватывающе.
bulgarian: While it's true that our namesake dragon is sleeping... I think the paintings look more exciting, showing them awake.

english: You ever notice how the paintings in the Inn's rooms are a matching set?
french: Tu as déjà remarqué que les tableaux dans les chambres de l'auberge allaient par paire ?
russian:
Ты

замечали

замечалазамечалзамечало, что картины в комнатах трактира похожи?
bulgarian: You ever notice how the paintings in the Inn's rooms are a matching set?

english: But I love to daydream about pie-in-the-sky additions for the Inn...
french: Mais je rêve souvent d'aménagements invraisemblables pour l'auberge.
russian: Но я иногда люблю фантазировать об идеальных улучшениях трактира...
bulgarian: But I love to daydream about pie-in-the-sky additions for the Inn...

english: Like, what if we had a big outdoor wood-fired oven? Or an extra floor for more guest rooms?
french: Imagine, un immense four à bois à l'extérieur ! Ou un étage supplémentaire pour avoir plus de chambres !
russian: Вот бы, например, у нас была дровяная печь во дворе! Или ещё один этаж с гостевыми комнатами!
bulgarian: Like, what if we had a big outdoor wood-fired oven? Or an extra floor for more guest rooms?

english: The Inn doesn't really need any of that... but lately it feels like anything is possible!
french: L'auberge s'en passe très bien... mais j'ai l'impression que rien n'est impossible ces derniers temps !
russian: Не то чтобы трактиру это очень нужно... Но теперь мне кажется, будто возможно всё!
bulgarian: The Inn doesn't really need any of that... but lately it feels like anything is possible!

english: Maybe this is silly...
french: C'est peut-être bête...
russian: Может быть, это глупо...
bulgarian: Maybe this is silly...

english: I can never resist an opportunity to make some treats!
french: Je ne laisse jamais passer une chance de préparer des petites choses à grignoter !
russian: Не могу удержаться и не приготовить что-нибудь вкусненькое!
bulgarian: I can never resist an opportunity to make some treats!

english: Here, try some!
french: Tiens, goûte !
russian: Вот, попробуй!
bulgarian: Here, try some!

english: Here! Close your eyes, put out your hand, and choose one: spicy or sweet!
french: Bon ! Ferme les yeux, donne ta main et choisis : sucré ou épicé ?
russian: Так, закрой глаза. Протяни руку и выбери: острое или сладкое!
bulgarian: Here! Close your eyes, put out your hand, and choose one: spicy or sweet!

english: Spicy!
french: Épicé !
russian: Острое!
bulgarian: Spicy!

english: Sweet!
french: Sucré !
russian: Сладкое!
bulgarian: Sweet!

english: Ooh, good choice!
french: Oh, excellent choix !
russian: О, отличный выбор!
bulgarian: Ooh, good choice!

english: Both my mom and dad love this one.
french: Aussi bien mon père que ma mère adorent ça.
russian: И маме и папе это нравится.
bulgarian: Both my mom and dad love this one.

english: The trick to making it is to never rub your eyes after cutting the chilis...
french: Le truc à ne pas oublier, c'est ne jamais se frotter les yeux après avoir émincé du piment...
russian: Главное при готовке — не тереть глаза, когда порежешь чили...
bulgarian: The trick to making it is to never rub your eyes after cutting the chilis...

english: Here, try some!
french: Tiens, goûte !
russian: Вот, попробуй!
bulgarian: Here, try some!

english: Ooh, good choice!
french: Oh, excellent choix !
russian: О, отличный выбор!
bulgarian: Ooh, good choice!

english: The trick to getting the caramelization right is keeping an eye on the stove.
french: Le truc pour que ça caramélise comme il faut, c'est de garder un œil sur la cuisinière.
russian: Чтобы добиться хорошей карамелизации, надо не спускать глаз с плиты.
bulgarian: The trick to getting the caramelization right is keeping an eye on the stove.

english: Sugar loves to burn the second you're looking away...
french: Le sucre brûle dès que tu as le dos tourné...
russian: Сахар любит пригорать, стоит только отвернуться...
bulgarian: Sugar loves to burn the second you're looking away...

english: My folks are planning a little get-together and I've deputized myself as Sheriff of Snacks.
french: Mes parents organisent une soirée en famille. Je me suis nommée Fée des petits fours.
